notes.title: Patch Notes 0.2.1.d
notes.notes:
[b]Known Issues[/b]
[list]
[*] Disappearing Warpaints & Warpaint duplication. We potentially fixed the disappearing Warpaints but we still rely on your feedback here. Please report anything related to this issue. We are still working on the Warpaint duplication bug. Thank you for your patience! <3
[/list]

[b]Added[/b]
[list]
[*] Added a new NPC returning your lost Pigments from before the system rework.
[*] New Warpaint forms added. Mythic and Legendary Warpaints will continue to use the same forms. Epic and Common Warpaints will now drop in smaller forms to compensate for their reduced power. To prevent your current loadouts from being affected, this does not apply retroactively to older Warpaints. More shapes will be added in the future.
[/list]

[b]Changed[/b]
[list]
[*] Blood Sacrifice rewards changed. We have changed the way that levels affect the rarity of Warpaints dropped by enemies and chests. The higher the level, the more likely you are to receive legendary or mythical Warpaints and the less likely you are to receive common or epic Warpaints. You can also see the exact chances for each rarity.
[/list]

[b]Fixed[/b]
[list]
[*] Potentially fixed a bug that resulted in losing equipped Warpaints. Please report any issues regarding this topic.
[*] Fixed a bug where the unique effect “Fortunes Favor” gave you a random ability at the start of the run instead of a free reroll each level up.
[*] Fixed a bug where the Valhalla mode was not properly reset after a full Blood Sacrifice reset.
[/list]

notes.title: 👀A Glimpse into the Next Major Update👀
notes.notes:
[b]Fellow Vikings![/b]

Here we are with a first look at the upcoming major update for [i]Asgard’s Fall[/i]! One of the headline changes is a [b]full overhaul of the Warpaint system[/b], with a ton of [b]long-requested improvements[/b] and [b]fresh mechanics[/b] that will shake up how you build and customize your characters.

[h3][b]Inventory Gets a Makeover[/b][/h3]
Warpaints now live side by side with your inventory, and managing your gear just got a whole lot smoother:
[b][list]
[*] Inventory now displayed right next to your Warpaint
[*] Filtering & sorting options for easier navigation
[*] Bigger inventory with multiple pages
[*] Mass dematerializing for faster cleanup
[*] Lock specific items to avoid accidents
[*] Build loadouts unique to each character
[*] See active Warpaint effects at a glance
[/list][/b]
Here's a scribble of the new inventory management menu for Warpaints:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44842723/0e2eb0268cc24561815581d14fa2888b62a0cf45.png[/img]

[h3][b]Warpaint Runes – New Structure, New Power[/b][/h3]
Warpaint recipes are gone—all their effects are now baked right into the Runes themselves. This new system is all about flexibility and surprise:
[b][list]
[*] Warpaints come in rarity tiers: Common, Epic, Legendary, Mythic, and Unique
[*] Each tier offers a different number of random stat bonuses
[list][*] Example: Common = 2 stats, Mythic = 4 stats[/list]
[*] Unique Runes feature an exclusive bonus effect that’s one-of-a-kind!
[*] The world pigment drops will also change in this respect, as the new pigments will then drop.
[/list][/b]
Check out the graphic below for a breakdown of rune rarities and stats!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44842723/573c8c7bff46698df235632b7c4d63260ed69f5d.png[/img]

[h3][b]Pigments and Crafting – What’s Next?[/b][/h3]
Pigments will also evolve alongside this update. Any pigments in your inventory will likely be converted automatically.

However, full Warpaint crafting is planned for a future update, as it's still under development and not ready for testing just yet.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44842723/f31e2ed461a07aa7ec9553141e77759e9e06ae9f.png[/img]

[h3][b]That’s all for now![/b][/h3]
The major update is dropping very soon, and we can’t wait to share it with you. We're also working on community beta branches to give you earlier access and more opportunities to shape each update as it grows together.

Stay sharp, warriors—and keep those brushes ready. The battlefield's about to get a lot more colorful.

[b]Skål!🍻
— Max & Vitali | The Asgard’s Fall Team[/b]

notes.title: Meet the new face of Asgard's Fall!
notes.notes:
Fellow heroes!

Thank you for your patience, it's been a while. But, we're pretty sure the wait was worth it ... because we've been cooking something for you!

There are two major points we'd like to address today, so let's get started.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44842723/9b31e8d8e913a1c8f3fddef688eff80da5c918ba.png[/img]

As we've already mentioned before, we've been busy recreating the 1.0 ([b]Origins[/b]) version of the game in a new engine. The game is now running smoothly with Game Maker instead of Unity; even though there've been some challenges, we're extremely happy with the current build. Hopefully, you'll like it as much. (Balancing issues aside ːsteamhappyː - feeling overpowered yet?)

The thing is, there's probably just bits of the initial [b]Origins[/b] DNA left, because the game has changed immensely. Even [b]Origins[/b] veterans will probably think it's a different game they're playing. We can't wait to hear your thoughts and feedback!

So, let's talk some of the biggest changes we've made:

[list]
[*] New engine (self-explanatory)
[*] New playable hero: the Huntress
[*] New hero-based skill trees (replaces previous elemental-based ones)
[*] New playable Realm: Muspelheim (hot hot hot)
[*] Realms have been increased in size (3x bigger)
[*] New Web of Wyrd (all-new dynamic skill system during a run; replaces the previous rune carving system)
[*] Both new and updated abilities
[*] New enemies and bosses
[*] Overhauled enemy attack pattern mechanics
[*] Added random world buffs that pop up during a run
[/list]
And since actions speak louder than words, we've got a surprise for you!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44842723/ab74c3f2668a78363e3004ef547b5939756e5ab9.png[/img]

Yes, you got that right! tl;dr: [b]The Playtest will start on August 19 already. (Exact time TBD; you'll notice.)[/b]

Since your feedback is invaluable and plays a vital role during the development of Asgard's Fall, we came up with the idea of making use of Steam's Playtest feature. It's basically a win-win situation. You get to play the latest build, and we get helpful feedback in return. Boom! 

This can also be seen as somewhat of a compensation for everyone that is not able to attend gamescom this year. Because, we will be there with the new Asgard's Fall build in the bag. If you're there, make sure to swing by and say hi. 

You'll find us here: [b]Home of Indies (IAHOI)  | Hall 10.2 Indie Area | Booth E010g - D011g | (Assemble Entertainment Publisher Booth)[/b]

Here's a brief lookout at what we'll be working on until release:

[*] Adding all of the Nine Realms
[*] Adding new abilities
[*] Adding new mechanics and systems

notes.title: Development Update
notes.notes:
Fellow Gamers,

this is Max from Soulpotion - one of the two developers of Asgard's Fall. I'd like to share some first-hand information about our current development status and the future of Asgard's Fall. You can expect more insights in the future from now on. ːsteamhappyː 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44842723/d8ea3e308a9b63936bcf7d242877d48ee3243da3.png[/img]

[h2]Where are we development-wise?[/h2]

We've recently transitioned from Unity to GameMaker Studio 2! Our priority has always been to provide a safe and stable environment for our game's development. Recent events around Unity raised concerns, leading us to explore alternatives. And we believe we've found the perfect match with GameMaker Studio 2! 


[h2]What to expect in the new version?[/h2]

[b]New and Improved Mechanics:[/b] We're introducing crafting and gathering systems! Collect resources and craft items that will aid you in your adventures.

[b]Revamped Skill Tree:[/b] A completely overhauled skill tree with new and more powerful options and strategies.

[b]New Characters:[/b] Introducing new Characters completely changing the way the game is played.

[b]Sword Engraving System:[/b] A unique feature to enhance your character! Customize your sword with powerful engravings that grant special abilities and bonuses.

[b]Much More:[/b] There are more things we're discussing and will give you more insight into once we've decided what will and won't make it into the game. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44448551/d8ea3e308a9b63936bcf7d242877d48ee3243da3.png[/img]

Oh, one more thing: to shorten the waiting time, we've decided to release the latest Unity version for free soon - like very soon. The version is called [b]Asgard's Fall: Origins[/b] from now on.

Yes, you heard right - [b]FOR FREE[/b]. The version does have some limitations of course, since we weren't finished yet. But, we hope you'll enjoy the [b]Asgard's Fall: Origins[/b] build in all its glory and the flaws it still might have. 

Feel free to share your thoughts, feedback and comments on [url=https://discord.com/invite/adgqgNXvfw]our Discord server[/url] or here on Steam in the discussion boards.

[b]We will share more information on when Asgard's Fall: Origins will be available very, very soon.[/b]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2780710/Asgards_Fall/

So, stay tuned for more exciting updates on our development status in the coming weeks and months. We're super excited to share more news soon. We can't thank you enough for all your support, and that you are part of our journey.

Greetings
the devs @Soulpotion
